mission: Reveal the invisible worlds that exist all around us.
privacyNote: Local-first where practical. Photographs and notes stay on this device unless you enable sync later.

sections.title: What is Hidden Landscapes?
sections.body: Hidden Landscapes is a Waypoint Studio framework for helping people see nature beyond normal human vision — infrared, ultraviolet, polarized light, animal vision, and more. It is not a filter gallery. It is education through beauty.

sections.title: Different Ways Nature Can Be Seen
sections.body: Every landscape holds more than the eye alone can register. These modes organize how Hidden Landscapes will teach, compare, and explain those other views.

sections.title: Technology
sections.body: Cameras, lenses, filters, and conversion systems that open wavelengths and light behaviors outside everyday photography.

sections.title: Species Vision
sections.body: Research-informed educational simulations of how other species may perceive a scene. Approximate translations — never exact animal experience.

sections.title: Infrared
sections.body: Near-infrared photography reveals foliage, heat-adjacent reflectance, and atmospheric depth that human vision barely notices.

sections.title: Full Spectrum
sections.body: Sensors and optics that admit a wider band of wavelengths, then interpret that signal into images we can study.

sections.title: Ultraviolet
sections.body: UV-sensitive capture and false-color renderings that uncover patterns invisible under ordinary daylight photography.

sections.title: Polarization
sections.body: Polarizing filters and analysis that quiet glare, deepen skies, and expose surface structure in water, leaves, and stone.

sections.title: Night
sections.body: Night vision and low-light techniques that keep form and atmosphere when the sun is gone.

sections.title: Gallery
sections.body: Image sets comparing human vision with infrared, UV, full spectrum, and species simulations will live here.

sections.title: Learn
sections.body: Scientific explanations, field notes, and guided lessons for each way of seeing.
